rows.note: Use this as the formal noun for a brief reference; everyday speech usually recasts the idea as a verb.

example.english: This report makes only a brief mention of the incident.
example.traditional: 呢份報告對事件只有簡短嘅提及。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 deoi3 si6 gin6 zi2 jau5 gaan2 dyun2 ge3 tai4 kap6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that someone mentioned or referred to something.

example.english: They mention that restaurant is pretty good.
example.traditional: 佢提到嗰間餐廳幾好食。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tai4 dou3 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this when bringing a person or topic up in conversation, often with the sense of mentioning it in passing.

example.english: Whenever I mention your son, everyone laughs.
example.traditional: 我一講起你個仔，大家就笑。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gong2 hei2 nei5 go3 zai2 daai6 gaa1 zau6 siu3
